title: Roll a die
description: A three.js die, as one motion you can play and scrub.

chapters.label: Shake
chapters.caption: The die rattles in the hand before the throw.

chapters.label: Throw
chapters.caption: Thrown, it spins fast as it arcs towards the table.

chapters.label: Bounce
chapters.caption: It bounces twice, each lower, losing spin each time.

chapters.label: Settle
chapters.caption: It rolls out the last of its spin and comes to rest.
